<p align="center"><strong>Find the sky bearing for the homeward path.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">The dome opens above a brass telescope. Four bright stars form a diamond. Below them, the treetops stretch like a dark sea.</p>

<p align="center">The telescope has three bearing marks: north, east and west. A chart explains which stars the nightkeeper trusted.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat watches a moving point of light with professional interest.</p>
